quarterly_data.signal: Semiconductor equipment (subsidiary Hanwha Semitech): the business comprises back-end advanced-packaging equipment -- TC bonders and hybrid bonders -- plus flip-chip bonders for general semiconductor manufacturing, and front-end PECVD and ALD deposition equipment (deposition business acquired 01-01-2024); building on volume-production experience with flip-chip bonders it is expanding in collaboration with major semiconductor makers. Main customers are global IDMs and OSATs; the company expects semiconductor equipment demand to keep growing at a high rate as AI drives demand for high-performance chips. H1 2026 semiconductor-equipment sales were KRW 42,090M, almost all domestic (KRW 41,629M; FY2025 total KRW 110,286M). Hanwha Semitech's land and buildings are pledged to SK Hynix as collateral for a delivery-contract performance guarantee (KRW 100,000,000 thousand). In H1 2026 Hanwha Vision took part in a Hanwha Semitech rights offering to expand its semiconductor equipment business. Hanwha Semitech is suing Hanmi Semiconductor (first instance pending, claim KRW 1,200,000,000) alleging its TC bonders infringe three Hanwha Semitech patents.
quarterly_data.figure: Semiconductor equipment sales KRW 42,090M (domestic KRW 41,629M); SK Hynix collateral KRW 100,000,000 thousand

quarterly_data.signal: Capacity and inputs, H1 2026 (value basis): Industrial Equipment (Changwon, Zhangjiagang) capacity KRW 312,105M, output KRW 196,766M, utilisation 63.04% (FY2025: 64.60%); Security (Bac Ninh, Vietnam) utilisation 94.92%. Semiconductor-equipment raw materials (control boards, linear scales etc.) KRW 56,544M, from Ames Industry, Heidenhain and others. Chip-mounter average prices: high-speed KRW 270M per unit (2025: KRW 250M), mid-speed KRW 180M (KRW 120M); overseas chip-mounter share 13.96% (PROTEC MDC data). No facility investment is in progress or planned. H1 R&D expense KRW 139,290,999 thousand (14% of revenue).
